header: The page's plan for N64Recomp-browser's tools/play_page.mjs, its regular play of 2-3 minutes: the launcher, Load ROM
on a new profile once the shader list Chrome builds behind the launcher is done (Firefox builds none there, and its
line saying so is the one waited for), Start Game, the logo and the title's Mario head, then Start (Enter) to the file
select and A (Space) on file A, where its cursor opens, as a player does. A new file plays its intro (Peach's letter,
Lakitu), passed with A until Mario is in control in the castle grounds, where he walks and jumps for about 10 s.
Bob-omb Battlefield is then warped into by tools/shader_survey.js as its painting does (patches/shader_survey.c): the
walk through the castle to the painting takes steering a script can't do reliably. Its act select is taken with A,
and Mario, kept at full health (setInvincible), plays about 60 s of the game's time from where the course starts him:
running out and back, jumping, a long jump, turning the camera both ways. Each step that stands on the one before is a
need that fails the run unless the level is the one playing and Mario is in control. The waits and holds are on the
game's own clock, gGlobalTimer (30 a second), so every browser moves him as far whatever frames it gives the game.
tools/play_plan_extended.json goes on to three more courses, for when a longer play is needed.
